This template is intended only for penalties missed during a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|shoot-out]] and not for any that are missed during the match itself.

== Usage ==
<code><nowiki>{{penmiss}}</nowiki></code>
*<code><nowiki>{{penmiss}}</nowiki> -> </code>{{penmiss}}
